description: Glazed ceramic mosaic tile from Pak Clay in a lantern shape, with multiple colours for bathroom walls. The elongated, pointed outline gives a patterned look for feature walls and shower backs, and the glaze is generally easier to wipe clean than unglazed clay. Multi-colour sheets can vary between pieces, so view a sample to judge the mix. Small mosaic tiles need careful setting, so ask your tiler about adhesive, grout and waterproofing. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your wall size and city for a dated quote.

Glazed ceramic mosaic tile from Pak Clay in a multi-colour Moroccan-style pattern, made for kitchen walls. The glazed surface is generally easy to wipe, which helps behind a hob or sink, and the patterned look suits a backsplash or feature wall. Colours can look different on screen, so check a sample in your own kitchen light. Ask your tiler about adhesive and grout for splash areas, and keep tiles from one batch. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your wall size and city for a dated quote.

Natural terracotta tile from Pak Clay for kitchen walls, in a multi-list mix of strips and pieces. Fired clay has a warm colour that runs through the body, with slight variation from piece to piece. Clay is porous, so ask your tiler about sealing, especially behind a hob or sink, where oil and water splash. Confirm the exact sizes in the mix before planning the wall, and view a sample first. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your wall size and city for a dated quote.
